nodes.statement: The norm is Euclidean; R^n and dx in Ex68/Ex69 are the standard Euclidean carrier and Lebesgue measure.
O(n)={O:O^T O=I_n} with full Haar probability. Each det=+1/-1 component has Haar mass 1/2; mu_{n,b} is Haar probability conditioned on det O=b.
For probability measures, TV(P,Q)=sup_{B measurable}|P(B)-Q(B)|=(1/2) integral |p-q| d lambda for any common dominating measure.
